title: Two-minute spots for silent air
lede: Sharper Image sold the Ionic Breeze with long-form infomercials and two-minute spots. These are uploads by collectors of old television, plus wire-service news of the bankruptcy and one retrospective. Where a date comes only from the uploader, the caption says so.

videos.title: Sharper Image “Q-Ball” commercial
videos.caption: A gadget spot from the catalog years. The date (“ca. 1999”) is the uploader’s.

videos.title: The Sharper Image Ionic Breeze infomercial (full)
videos.caption: A half-hour infomercial for the purifier that would become 40% of revenue by fiscal 2004.[^1] The 2001 date is the uploader’s.

videos.title: Ionic Breeze Quadra two-minute spot
videos.caption: A two-minute spot from the peak year. The 2004 date is the uploader’s.

videos.title: Ionic Breeze Quadra commercial, September 2006
videos.caption: The uploader dates this airing to September 25, 2006, the day Richard Thalheimer left the company.[^2] We have not verified the air date.

videos.title: AP Money Minute: Sharper Image goes belly up
videos.caption: Associated Press video on the February 2008 bankruptcy filing.[^7]

videos.title: Do you remember The Sharper Image? The rise and fall
videos.caption: A fan retrospective, embedded as commentary; no figure on this page is taken from it. The year is approximate, from the upload age YouTube shows.
